title: Jinchuriki Mastery
body:
Syntax: jinchuriki | mastery

Shows your sealed Tailed Beast, its tail count, and your exact mastery percentage from 0% to 100%. This is separate from ordinary skill proficiency. Mastery grows through combat while carrying a beast; rampage risk ends at 65%, and beastmode becomes available at 100%. Viewing this display costs nothing and does not toggle Beastmode. If you have no sealed beast, the command says so.
